text:
Elliot: Heads-up: noticed some odd entries on the per-model mini-card. For tenant Q, 'redwood-base' shows token_cost $0.27, cache_savings $0.65, net displayed as -$0.38. Screenshot in thread.
Sam: ugh. is that the exploration card or billing view?
Elliot: exploration (24h). It started after we flipped the new routing heuristics canary yesterday.
Rin: could be two separate causes: 1) cache credits amortized across session slabs, 2) telemetry sampling mismatch between router spans and token ingest. We saw similar in other threads but want a focused plan.
Tao: quick repro: query econ_rollups for tenant Q in staging:

```
SELECT route_id, model_sku, token_cost_24h, cache_credit_24h, cache_credit_7d_amortized, sample_coverage
FROM econ_rollups_v2
WHERE tenant_id='Q' AND window_start >= now()- interval '1 day';
```

Tao: result: token_cost_24h=0.27, cache_credit_24h=0.65, cache_credit_7d_amortized=1.9, sample_coverage=11%.
Sam: that sample_coverage is very low. With 11% we can easily over-attribute credits.
Elliot: UX question: should console show raw cache_credit_24h or a cleaned metric? Users will freak if savings > cost.
Rin: propose three-layer approach: (A) fix attribution alignment long-term (propagate sampled_span_id and join deterministically), (B) emit both 24h and amortized 7d fields in rollup, (C) console shows a derived "estimated cache savings" by default (min(cache_credit_24h, token_cost_24h)) and a confidence pill.
Sam: agree. For (A) I'll open RED-ENG-5001 to propagate sampled_span_id through the router traces and cache-cred pipeline. That lets us join deterministically in the rollup.
Tao: for (B) I can update the rollup job to include sample_count and both windows. SQL sketch:

```
SELECT tenant_id, route_id, model_sku,
  SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '1 day') AS token_cost_24h,
  SUM(cache_credit) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '1 day') AS cache_credit_24h,
  SUM(cache_credit) FILTER (WHERE window >= now()- interval '7 day')/7.0 AS cache_credit_7d_amortized,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sampled=true) AS sample_count
FROM econ_events
GROUP BY tenant_id, route_id, model_sku;
```

Rin: include a rollup_version and provenance field so downstream consumers know which logic produced the numbers.
Elliot: for (C) the console should compute displayed_savings client-side behind a feature flag first. Microcopy: "Estimated cache savings (clamped to observed token cost). Based on sampled telemetry; confidence shown."
Sam: confidence pill logic: sample_coverage <25% => low, 25-75 => med, >75 => high. Also show an uncertainty hint when low: "Estimates may exceed observed cost when coverage is low."
Tao: small caveat: alerts and billing must use canonical fields from rollup. We should not let console clamp silently change billing numbers. Add a field cache_savings_ui_clamped as convenience, but billing API uses cache_credit_7d_amortized only.
Rin: rollout plan: 1) RED-ENG-5001 (span id propagation) -> land infra changes, 2) RED-ENG-5002 (rollup schema v2 emit windows + sample_count + provenance), 3) RED-ENG-5003 (console feature flag compute clamped display). Canary: 10 tenants for 48h.
metrics-bot: Created issues RED-ENG-5001, RED-ENG-5002, RED-ENG-5003 and scheduled canary for RED-ENG-5003 (env=canary).
Elliot: also add an anomaly QA alert: if cache_credit_24h > token_cost_24h * 2 AND sample_coverage <30% then flag for manual review (non-billing).
Sam: will add RED-ENG-5004 for alert rules.
Tao: dev tasks: update rollup unit tests to include low-coverage sample scenarios and ensure clamped_display produced by console matches backend-provided convenience field when flag enabled.
Rin: UX ask: show a small info icon linking to docs that explain amortization windows and sampling, and add a toggle on the panel to switch between 'recent (24h)' and 'billing basis (7d)'.
Elliot: yep — default to 'recent (24h)' in exploration, default to 'billing (7d)' in billing pages. Keep the toggle state per-user.
Sam: timeline: infra PRs this week, rollup v2 in staging early next week, console UI flag + canary mid next week.
Elliot: thanks — I'll attach the tenant samples and screenshots to RED-ENG-5002. Ping if anyone wants to pair on the sampling join changes.
Rin: thanks team :thumbsup:
